predictions.title: CISA pairs agentic-AI CVE remediation with capability attestation by Q3 2026
predictions.body: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE wave converging across the May 8 to May 11 window forces CISA to publish a Binding Operational Directive that treats per-CVE remediation status and per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs as paired federal-civilian-executive-branch procurement and operating requirements, with the operative review cadence pegged to the May 21 n8n CVE-2026-21858 federal-civilian remediation deadline. The catalysts landing in a single news cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: the AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint-deserialization remote-code-execution path plus the Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest authenticated server-side request forgery to internal cloud-metadata endpoints extend the May 8 CrewAI plus Haystack and the earlier LangGraph plus LiteLLM CVE cluster across the full Microsoft open-source agent stack inside one weekend, with Trail of Bits cataloging the shared agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; CISA's Sunday-edition KEV catalog note expressly reminds federal-civilian-executive-branch agencies of the May 21 n8n remediation deadline while the agentic-AI CVE wave compounds on top; the Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center director plus the NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director joining the May 15 S-407 classified Frontier Model Review Board threshold briefing carries the operational view of Mythos-class capability exposure on enterprise tenants directly into the executive-order interagency-review conversation; the Sunday three-hyperscaler registry interop matrix (AWS Bedrock public-preview FedRAMP-Moderate pull-forward, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center adding Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop, and the Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog mirroring the South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields in the tenant-policy schema alongside the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI integration) demonstrates that the cross-vendor compliance plumbing already exists across all six Indo-Pacific reciprocity-cohort jurisdictions; the May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof for per-tenant capability attestation plus the May 10 arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant compositional safety theorem give the directive drafters a citable formal-verification anchor; and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare plus LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 plus LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 plus CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391, now with AutoGen and Semantic Kernel as obvious additions) already demonstrates the publishable per-CVE blocklist shape that an allied public-sector procurement regime can pair with the attestation-log evidence requirement. The structural force is that the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline arrives before the May 22 earliest FMRB executive-order signing window, leaving CISA as the operative federal-civilian-executive-branch enforcement vehicle while the policy regime is still in interagency review; the agency cannot let the AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel disclosure pattern sit as a coincidence after publishing four prior agentic-platform KEV additions in three weeks. The most likely shape is a Binding Operational Directive scoping agentic-AI workflow platforms (named explicitly to include n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) with a paired requirement: per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation log evidence (the Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive plus the formal-verification framework from the arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 papers as the cited compliance evidence) on a federal-civilian estate, with the review cadence aligned to the n8n CVE-2026-21858 May 21 deadline. Sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants comply first because the AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex public-preview interop matrix already exposes the attestation-log field. Bear case is that the FMRB executive order ships first with the agentic-AI workflow scope pre-empted; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the directive across the federal-civilian-executive-branch perimeter.

predictions.summary: May 10 AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 and Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 extend the agentic-AI CVE wave across the Microsoft agent stack; the May 21 federal-civilian n8n deadline arrives before the FMRB EO signs. By Q3 2026 CISA pairs CVE remediation with per-tenant Mythos attestation in a directive.
